title: Bold and Wildheart have their own kit email set (note, welcome, dates, receipt) in their own tokens, with coaching defaults

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-18: "Survey EVERY theme and make sure they have their full design system and all 4 parts, with all templates. Spotlight, Space, Website and Email templates."

detail: Survey 2026-11-18 (themes-complete-2026-11-18/SURVEY.md): Bold and Wildheart were the only offered themes with no kit email set. One frame (lib/theme/house-kit-email.ts) carries the four templates; each theme wears its own flat token set from lib/theme/mega-surfaces.ts (the owner's accent over the theme's when it is a real hex) and its own faces (Bold: Sofia Sans Extra Condensed uppercase, square corners; Wildheart: IM Fell English with an italic accent word, pill buttons). Every default coaches what to write (Daniel 2026-11-18: "Make every Frequency theme FULLY generic with copy that coaches them what to write"), and the stock catalog shows all eight (bold-kit-*, wildheart-kit-*) with generic sample copy, no invented studio.
